title: Attack on Titan: Requiem — Story-Focused Alternate Ending Quiz Bank
adaptationBoundary: Fan-created alternate continuity only. This quiz covers the released AoT no Requiem fan project and clearly labeled thematic interpretations; it is not official Attack on Titan canon. The project diverges from the original manga after chapters 1–136 and reimagines the ending.
notes: 75 story-focused questions across five units, 15 questions per unit.
The project is fan-made and unofficial; the original manga remains canon.
Questions about the Rumbling and the original ending are context for the alternate scenario. Interpretive questions are phrased as best-reading questions rather than claims of hidden canon.
Part 2 and Part 3 reader-metadata trivia has been removed.
